company.name: Lucis
company.shortDescription: Lucis combines lab testing, wearable data, and health insights to help individuals understand and improve their biology.
company.description: Lucis is a preventive health platform that combines laboratory testing, wearable data, and educational health insights to help users better understand their biological markers and lifestyle patterns. The company provides recurring wellness assessments that analyze more than 100 biomarkers across areas such as metabolism, cardiovascular health, hormones, recovery, immunity, and sleep, with results presented through a digital dashboard and personalized action plans. Lucis works with accredited laboratory partners across Europe and integrates data from devices such as smartwatches and fitness trackers to give users a broader view of their health trends over time. The platform also offers guidance related to nutrition, exercise, recovery, and daily habits, while emphasizing that its services are educational and not a replacement for medical diagnosis or treatment. In addition, Lucis states that it follows GDPR compliance and ISO 27001 information security standards to protect user health data.
